en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Hakam Bin Hukeym, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I asked himasws about the rinsing (of the mouth) and the sniffing (of the water), is it (part) of the Ablution (Wudhu)?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from Hakam ibn Hukaym who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’
Is rinsing one’s mouth and nostrils part of Wudu’?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, they are not part of Wudu’.’”
